name: Data Converter
description: Convert between JSON, YAML, XML, and Properties in one DBX workbench panel, and turn batch text into SQL. Instant conversion, mock data, validation and formatting, field-level JSON diff, a standalone JSON compare page, line-level text compare, and an IN / NOT IN / INSERT value-list generator. Pure frontend, no backend, works offline.
releaseNotes: 0.1.4: a SQL builder page — paste one value per line (or a whole IN (...)/VALUES (...) fragment) and get IN / NOT IN / value list / INSERT, with quote style, number quoting (on by default), dedupe and one-per-line formatting. The seven format pairs now live in a single Convert dropdown in the nav. Still fully offline, with no backend.
